intendedDiff: Accept only caller-supplied viewer-authorized presence snapshots, translate them into the existing continuous public follow signals, and emit a presentation-only spectator attach intent only for an authorized spectatable live match. No transport discovery or gameplay mutation is added.
idempotency: New-file-only seam on an isolated branch. Same authorized live match uses the existing continuous-follow idempotency and deterministic attach-intent identity. Existing follow core stays read-only.
checks: current PR checks / Required Gate when triggered
rollback: Close the PR and delete/revert only this branch's new files. No shared core rollback is required.
resume: If main advances before merge, revalidate current main and replay the exact two-file product diff on a fresh authorized branch; never widen into private match discovery.
